title: Repulsive Population Policy Gradients for Behaviorally Diverse Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.36425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The goal of Quality-Diversity Reinforcement Learning (QD-RL) is to find a population of high-performing policies that solve a decision-making problem in diverse ways. Despite recent progress, QD-RL methods predominantly rely on evolutionary operators--including black-box optimizers, mutations, and crossovers--to facilitate exploration and induce diversity. Scaling these methods becomes increasingly costly as policies and behavior spaces grow larger. Building on the Soft QD view of quality-diversity optimization, we introduce \textbf{Re}pulsive \textbf{P}opulation \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization (\textbf{RePPO}), which adapts PPO to jointly optimize a compact population of diverse, high-quality policies using a population-dependent, dynamically shaped reward. translated_title: 面向行为多样性强化学习的排斥性种群策略梯度
translated_abstract: 质量-多样性强化学习的目标是寻找一组高性能策略，以多样化的方式解决决策问题。尽管近年来取得了进展，QD-RL方法主要依赖进化算子——包括黑盒优化器、变异和交叉——来促进探索并诱导多样性。随着策略和行为空间规模的增大，扩展这些方法的成本变得越来越高。基于质量-多样性优化的Soft QD视角，我们提出了排斥性种群策略优化，它对PPO进行改造，利用一种依赖于种群且动态塑形的奖励，联合优化一个由多样化、高质量策略组成的紧凑种群。在标准连续控制任务上，与最先进的QD-RL方法相比，RePPO实现了出色的质量-多样性权衡。消融实验进一步刻画了这一权衡特性。
tldr: 提出RePPO，通过改造PPO并引入依赖种群的动态塑形奖励来联合优化一个紧凑的多样化高质量策略种群，从而在连续控制任务上实现了优于现有QD-RL方法的质量-多样性权衡，摆脱了对昂贵进化算子的依赖。
en_tdlr: RePPO adapts PPO with a population-dependent, dynamically shaped reward to jointly optimize a compact population of diverse, high-quality policies, achieving a strong quality-diversity tradeoff on continuous-control tasks compared to state-of-the-art QD-RL methods without relying on costly evolutionary operators.
